SELECT T2.compagnia, COUNT(T1.id) AS numero_voli FROM volo AS T1 INNER JOIN rotta AS T2 ON T1.rotta = T2.id WHERE T1.modello_aereo = 'B737-800' GROUP BY T2.compagnia ORDER BY numero_voli DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.compagnia, COUNT(T1.id) AS numero_voli
FROM volo AS T1
JOIN rotta AS T2 ON T1.rotta = T2.id
WHERE T1.modello_aereo = 'B737-800'
GROUP BY T2.compagnia
ORDER BY numero_voli DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.compagnia, COUNT(T1.id) AS numero_voli 
FROM volo AS T1 
INNER JOIN rotta AS T2 ON T1.rotta = T2.id 
WHERE T1.modello_aereo = 'B737-800' 
GROUP BY T2.compagnia 
ORDER BY numero_voli DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT rotta.compagnia, COUNT(volo.id) AS numero_voli
FROM volo
JOIN rotta ON volo.rotta = rotta.id
WHERE volo.modello_aereo = 'B737-800'
GROUP BY rotta.compagnia
ORDER BY numero_voli DESC
LIMIT 1;
